segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about an uncomfortable subject, not because it's uncomfortable to talk about, but because it's, well, it doesn't really feel good when you have to go do it.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是一个不舒服的话题，不是因为谈论它不舒服，而是因为它，嗯，当你必须去做的时候，感觉并不好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to the doctor, but because we need to get vaccines.
segments.zh: 今天我们要去看医生，但因为我们需要接种疫苗。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So vaccines, these are, well, let's listen out during the dialogue and maybe you can guess what this word means when we come back, we'll be defining it for you, talking about different kinds of vaccines, but just remember that we're talking about going to the doctor to get these shots.
segments.zh: 所以疫苗，好吧，让我们在对话中听听，也许你可以猜到当我们回来时这个词意味着什么，我们会为你定义它，谈论不同种类的疫苗，但请记住，我们正在谈论去看医生来拍这些疫苗。

segments.zh: 所以让我们听听那个对话。

segments.en: Hello Mrs. Parker.
segments.zh: 您好，帕克夫人。

segments.en: How have you been?
segments.zh: 你最近怎么样？

segments.en: Hello, Dr. Peters.
segments.zh: 您好，彼得斯医生。

segments.en: Just fine.
segments.zh: 挺好的。

segments.en: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。

segments.en: Ricky and I are here for his vaccines.
segments.zh: 我带瑞奇来打预防针。

segments.en: Very well.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: According to the vaccination record, Ricky has received his polio, tetanus and hepatitis B shots.
segments.zh: 根据接种记录，瑞奇已经打过脊髓灰质炎、破伤风和乙肝疫苗。

segments.en: He is 14 months old, so he is due for hepatitis A, chicken pox and measles shots.
segments.zh: 他现在十四个月大，该接种甲肝、水痘和麻疹疫苗了。

segments.en: What about rubella and mumps?
segments.zh: 那风疹和腮腺炎疫苗呢？

segments.en: Well, I can only give him these for now and after a couple of weeks I can administer the rest.
segments.zh: 现在只能先给他打这几种，过几周再接种其余的。

segments.en: Okay, great.
segments.zh: 好，太好了。

segments.en: Doctor, I think I also may need a tetanus booster.
segments.zh: 医生，我想我可能也需要补打一针破伤风疫苗。

segments.en: Last time I got it was maybe 15 years ago.
segments.zh: 上次打好像是十五年前了。

segments.en: We'll check our records and I'll have the nurse administer the booster as well.
segments.zh: 我们会查一下记录，也让护士给您补打一针。

segments.en: Now please hold Ricky's arm tight.
segments.zh: 现在请按住瑞奇的胳膊。

segments.en: This may sting a little.
segments.zh: 可能会有一点刺痛。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at all of these words that are a little bit difficult, but we'll try to define them on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看所有这些有点困难的词，但我们将尝试在语言外卖上定义它们。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So Marco, first off, what is a vaccine?
segments.zh: 那么马可，首先，什么是疫苗？

segments.en: So a vaccine we can say is a type of medicine.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说的疫苗是一种药物。

segments.en: But it's basically an injection or medicine where you're helping a person defend him or herself against a specific type of disease.
segments.zh: 但它基本上是一种注射或药物，您可以帮助一个人保护他或她自己免受特定类型的疾病的侵害。

segments.en: Okay, so vaccination is medicine you receive before you're sick so that in the future you won't get sick with that disease.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以疫苗接种是你生病前接受的药物，这样你以后就不会生病。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's a vaccine.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种疫苗。

segments.en: There are many, many different types of vaccines.
segments.zh: 有许多不同类型的疫苗。

segments.en: And of course, when you do get them, you need to keep track of them via a vaccination record.
segments.zh: 当然，当你得到它们时，你需要通过疫苗接种记录来跟踪它们。

segments.en: So a record is basically a list or a document that shows what has been done.
segments.zh: 因此，记录基本上是一个列表或文档，显示已完成的操作。

segments.en: And this is very important when you go to the doctor to have a record of the things that you have received, the vaccines you've received.
segments.zh: 当您去看医生记录您收到的东西以及您收到的疫苗时，这一点非常重要。

segments.en: So for example, if I have a baby and I want the baby to have vaccinations, we'd have to keep a record of all of his vaccinations.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果我有一个孩子并且我希望婴儿接种疫苗，我们必须记录他所有的疫苗接种情况。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we are, obviously we get different vaccines at different stages in our life.
segments.zh: 所以我们是，显然我们在生活的不同阶段获得了不同的疫苗。

segments.en: Let's talk about some of the ones that we're taking a look at today.
segments.zh: 让我们谈谈我们今天要看的一些内容。

segments.en: So for example, we have a tetanus vaccine or a tetanus shot.
segments.zh: 例如，我们有破伤风疫苗或破伤风疫苗。

segments.en: All right, the tetanus shot is very famous because it's maybe the most painful.
segments.zh: 好吧，破伤风疫苗非常有名，因为它可能是最痛苦的。

segments.en: It really makes you sore for a little while.
segments.zh: 它真的让你酸痛一会儿。

segments.en: And most people get the tetanus shot when they're very young.
segments.zh: 大多数人在很小的时候就被打破了破伤风。

segments.en: This prevents you from getting the disease tetanus.
segments.zh: 这可以防止您感染破伤风。

segments.en: And tetanus is something you can get from animals or from dirty nails, dirty metal, anything that pokes out at you.
segments.zh: 破伤风是你可以从动物或肮脏的指甲、肮脏的金属以及任何刺向你的东西中获得的东西。

segments.en: And so you get the tetanus shot, but then after your tetanus shot, every five or 10 years, you need to get a booster shot.
segments.zh: 所以你得到了破伤风疫苗，但在你的破伤风疫苗之后，每隔 5 或 10 年，你就需要进行一次助推器射击。

segments.en: So there's the tetanus shot and there's the tetanus booster.
segments.zh: 所以有破伤风疫苗，还有破伤风助推器。

segments.en: So when we talk about a booster, when we're talking about vaccines, is basically you are reinforcing it.
segments.zh: 所以当我们谈论助推器时，当我们谈论疫苗时，基本上是你在加强它。

segments.en: You are making it stronger because obviously over time it becomes weak.
segments.zh: 你正在让它变得更强大，因为显然随着时间的推移它变得虚弱。

segments.en: The medicine won't last forever.
segments.zh: 药物不会永远持续下去。

segments.en: So you need to get a booster to make sure that you are still protected.
segments.zh: 因此，您需要获得助推器以确保您仍然受到保护。

segments.en: Basically it's an update.
segments.zh: 基本上是更新。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we have tetanus and tetanus booster, but we have another kind of vaccine.
segments.zh: 所以我们有破伤风和破伤风助推器，但我们有另一种疫苗。

segments.en: The disease here is called hepatitis.
segments.zh: 这里的疾病称为肝炎。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're taking a look at hepatitis B and hepatitis A. So there are different types of hepatitis.
segments.zh: 所以我们来看看乙型肝炎和甲型肝炎。所以有不同类型的肝炎。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So both kinds of hepatitis you can catch from other people.
segments.zh: 所以这两种肝炎你都可以从其他人那里感染。

segments.en: Although hepatitis A, I believe you can catch from saliva or contact.
segments.zh: 虽然甲型肝炎，我相信你可以从唾液或接触中捕获。

segments.en: Whereas hepatitis B you catch from other people's blood or if you have a relationship with someone.
segments.zh: 而乙型肝炎是你从别人的血液中感染的，或者你是否与某人有关系。

segments.en: So hepatitis A and B are different.
segments.zh: 所以甲型和乙型肝炎是不同的。

segments.en: Hepatitis B affects your liver and so there's different kinds of severity here.
segments.zh: 乙型肝炎会影响您的肝脏，因此这里有不同类型的严重程度。

segments.en: Now hepatitis A and B there are vaccinations for.
segments.zh: 现在甲型和乙型肝炎有疫苗接种。

segments.en: You can get those shots and it's very important if you're traveling to places that require them so that you don't get sick.
segments.zh: 您可以拍摄这些照片，如果您要去需要它们的地方旅行，这非常重要，这样您就不会生病。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, well, these different types of hepatitis, they are dangerous, right?
segments.zh: 所以，好吧，这些不同类型的肝炎，它们很危险，对吧？

segments.en: And they could be fatal.
segments.zh: 他们可能是致命的。

segments.en: But another one that's very, very common, especially with young kids, we have chicken pox.
segments.zh: 但另一种非常非常常见，尤其是对于年幼的孩子，我们有水痘。

segments.en: Chicken pox.
segments.zh: 水痘。

segments.en: Now it's kind of a funny name, chicken pox, P-O-X.
segments.zh: 现在它是一个有趣的名字，水痘，P-O-X。

segments.en: But it's also like you say, very common.
segments.zh: 但这也就像你说的，很常见。

segments.en: So basically the symptoms are what?
segments.zh: 所以基本上症状是什么？

segments.en: You get these red bumps all over your body and they itch.
segments.zh: 你的身体会出现这些红色的肿块，它们会发痒。

segments.en: You want to scratch and scratch and scratch.
segments.zh: 你想划伤、划伤和划伤。

segments.en: And so I remember when I had this, I was a little kid.
segments.zh: 所以我记得当我有这个时，我还是个小孩。

segments.en: My mom said, don't scratch because if you scratch, it will leave a mark.
segments.zh: 我妈妈说，不要刮伤，因为如果你抓挠，它会留下痕迹。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It leaves a scar.
segments.zh: 它留下了疤痕。

segments.en: So yeah, chicken pox, you get these little rashes all over your body.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，水痘，你全身都会出现这些小皮疹。

segments.en: They're very itchy, but they will go away with time.
segments.zh: 它们很痒，但它们会随着时间的推移而消失。

segments.en: Now it's usually, I've heard that it's recommended that people get it.
segments.zh: 现在通常，我听说它建议人们得到它。

segments.en: Actually you should get it when you're young because it's more dangerous if you get it as an adult.
segments.zh: 实际上，你应该在你年轻的时候得到它，因为如果你成年后会更危险。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's very painful as an adult.
segments.zh: 作为一个成年人，这是非常痛苦的。

segments.en: So basically chicken pox, they say if you get it once, you can't get it again.
segments.zh: 所以基本上水痘，他们说如果你得到它一次，你就不能再得到它。

segments.en: You'll never get it again.
segments.zh: 你再也不会得到它了。

segments.en: So if you get it as an adult, it's shingles, it's very painful.
segments.zh: 所以如果你成年后得到它，它是带状疱疹，它是非常痛苦的。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So we've taken a look at a lot of vocab here.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这里看了很多词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we now jump to another section.
segments.zh: 为什么我们现在不跳到另一个部分。

segments.en: Let's continue talking about these different types of vaccines.
segments.zh: 让我们继续讨论这些不同类型的疫苗。

segments.en: Let's go to language takeaway part two.
segments.zh: 让我们去第二部分语言外卖。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we have this special category of vaccinations.
segments.zh: 所以我们有这种特殊的疫苗接种类别。

segments.en: They usually go together.
segments.zh: 他们通常一起去。

segments.en: We have mumps, measles, and rubella, or there's a special acronym, MMR, mumps, measles, rubella.
segments.zh: 我们有腮腺炎、麻疹和风疹，或者有一个特殊的首字母缩略词、MMR、腮腺炎、麻疹、风疹。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you basically get like a little combo.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上得到了一个小组合。

segments.en: You usually get all three of them at one go.
segments.zh: 您通常会一口气获得所有三个。

segments.en: So what are these measles?
segments.zh: 那么这些麻疹是什么？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Measles.
segments.zh: 麻疹。

segments.en: Well, measles is a virus.
segments.zh: 嗯，麻疹是一种病毒。

segments.en: He's got the measles.
segments.zh: 他有麻疹。

segments.en: You often read books from like the 19th century where everyone gets the measles when they're a child.
segments.zh: 你经常阅读像 19 世纪这样的书，每个人在小时候都会患上麻疹。

segments.en: But measles is basically a virus, but it's kind of like the chicken pox because you get a rash on your skin.
segments.zh: 但麻疹基本上是一种病毒，但它有点像水痘，因为你的皮肤会出现皮疹。

segments.en: And is it fatal?
segments.zh: 它是致命的吗？

segments.en: Can you die from the measles?
segments.zh: 你会死于麻疹吗？

segments.en: I think in the old days you could, but these days it's pretty, pretty easy to take care of.
segments.zh: 我认为在过去你可以，但现在它很漂亮，很容易照顾。

segments.en: And what about mumps?
segments.zh: 那么腮腺炎呢？

segments.en: Now mumps, I'm not too sure about this, but I've heard that mumps is like a swelling in the space between your jaw and your ear.
segments.zh: 现在腮腺炎，我不太确定，但我听说腮腺炎就像你下巴和耳朵之间的空间膨胀。

segments.en: So you know where your ear kind of comes down to your jaw.
segments.zh: 所以你知道你的耳朵在哪里落到你的下巴上。

segments.en: That part of your head starts to swell and is very uncomfortable.
segments.zh: 你头部的那部分开始膨胀，非常不舒服。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And it could cause, like the consequences could be fatal, right?
segments.zh: 它可能会导致，就像后果可能是致命的一样，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So what about rubella?
segments.zh: 那么风疹呢？

segments.en: Rubella is another kind of rash.
segments.zh: 风疹是另一种皮疹。

segments.en: And from my reading, I saw that rubella is not very dangerous for most people, but it is very dangerous for pregnant women.
segments.zh: 从我的阅读来看，我看到风疹对大多数人来说不是很危险，但对孕妇来说非常危险。

segments.en: So most pregnant women are tested for rubella or the rubella vaccine, and they're told to get the vaccine before they're pregnant so that they don't get this disease and harm their baby because they can have a miscarriage if they get rubella while they're pregnant.
segments.zh: 因此，大多数孕妇都接受了风疹或风疹疫苗的检测，并被告知在怀孕之前接种疫苗，这样她们就不会感染这种疾病并伤害他们的婴儿，因为如果她们在怀孕期间患上风疹可能会流产。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: Okay, so pretty much you want to get all these vaccines to make sure that you don't get sick in the future.
segments.zh: 好吧，你几乎想接种这些疫苗，以确保你将来不会生病。

segments.en: Now, when we were talking about getting the vaccines, the doctor said, he didn't say you're going to get the vaccines or I'm going to give you a vaccine.
segments.zh: 现在，当我们谈论接种疫苗时，医生说，他并没有说你要接种疫苗，或者我要给你打疫苗。

segments.en: He said, I'll have the nurse administer the vaccine or administer the booster.
segments.zh: 他说，我会让护士接种疫苗或使用助推器。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the verb here that we use with vaccine is to administer.
segments.zh: 所以我们与疫苗一起使用的动词是管理。

segments.en: And this is something that the nurse does or the doctor does.
segments.zh: 这是护士或医生所做的事情。

segments.en: And it's just a way to say that the nurse will give you this shot, to give you a shot.
segments.zh: 这只是一种说护士会给你这个镜头，给你一个镜头的方式。

segments.en: But administer is more formal.
segments.zh: 但管理更正式。

segments.en: It's more common in the medical kind of medical talk.
segments.zh: 这在医学对话中更为常见。

segments.en: So you'd say administer the test or administer the vaccine.
segments.zh: 所以你会说进行测试或管理疫苗。

segments.en: So for example, a doctor would say, I'm going to administer a shot of penicillin.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，医生会说，我将服用一针青霉素。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or I'm going to administer this blood test.
segments.zh: 或者我要进行这个验血。

segments.en: That means I'm actually going to do it right now.
segments.zh: 这意味着我现在实际上会这样做。

segments.en: Now, obviously these vaccines, some of them you can take as a little pill.
segments.zh: 现在，显然这些疫苗，其中一些你可以服用一点药丸。

segments.en: Some of them you can take as drops, like, you know, it's very painless, but some of them you have to get a shot and sometimes they do hurt.
segments.zh: 其中一些你可以作为滴剂，比如，你知道，它非常无痛，但其中一些你必须打针，有时它们确实会受伤。

segments.en: And we saw in the dialogue that the doctor said, this may sting a little.
segments.zh: 我们在对话中看到医生说的，这可能有点刺痛。

segments.en: Doctors always say this before they give you a shot.
segments.zh: 医生总是在给你一针之前说这话。

segments.en: This may sting a little.
segments.zh: 可能会有一点刺痛。

segments.en: Now sting is a verb that means to hurt, but it's not like I hit you in the face, boom, it stings.
segments.zh: 现在sting是一个动词，意思是伤害，但它不像我打你的脸，砰，它刺痛。

segments.en: No, a sting is like a kind of a very kind of light hurt.
segments.zh: 不，刺痛就像一种非常轻微的光伤害。

segments.en: It's like a pinch.
segments.zh: 这就像一个捏。

segments.en: It's like a small, sharp pain, small, sharp pain.
segments.zh: 这就像一个小而尖锐的疼痛，小而尖锐的疼痛。

segments.en: That's a good way to describe it.
segments.zh: 这是描述它的好方法。

segments.en: So oftentimes we talk about bees, you know, bees that fly around, they sting you.
segments.zh: 所以我们经常谈论蜜蜂，你知道，蜜蜂会飞来飞去，它们会刺痛你。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a small, sharp pain.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个小而剧烈的疼痛。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.zh: 你好，帕克夫人。

segments.zh: 你最近怎么样？

segments.zh: 您好，彼得斯医生。

segments.en: Just fine, thank you.
segments.zh: 就好了，谢谢。

segments.en: Ricky and I are here for his vaccines.
segments.zh: 我带瑞奇来打预防针。

segments.en: Very well.

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: According to his vaccination record, Ricky has received his polio, tetanus and hepatitis B shots.
segments.zh: 根据他的疫苗接种记录，Ricky 接种了脊髓灰质炎、破伤风和乙型肝炎疫苗。

segments.en: He is 14 months old, so he is due for hepatitis A, chicken pox and measles shots.
segments.zh: 他现在十四个月大，该接种甲肝、水痘和麻疹疫苗了。

segments.en: What about rubella and mumps?
segments.zh: 那风疹和腮腺炎疫苗呢？

segments.en: Well, I can only give him these for now and after a couple of weeks I can administer the rest.
segments.zh: 现在只能先给他打这几种，过几周再接种其余的。

segments.en: Okay, great.
segments.zh: 好，太好了。

segments.en: Doctor, I think I also may need a tetanus booster.
segments.zh: 医生，我想我可能也需要补打一针破伤风疫苗。

segments.en: Last time I got it was maybe 15 years ago.
segments.zh: 上次打好像是十五年前了。

segments.en: We'll check our records and I'll have the nurse administer the booster as well.
segments.zh: 我们会查一下记录，也让护士给您补打一针。

segments.en: Now please hold Ricky's arm tight.
segments.zh: 现在请按住瑞奇的胳膊。

segments.en: This may sting a little.
segments.zh: 可能会有一点刺痛。

segments.en: So nowadays, most of these shots are administered when the babies are just born.
segments.zh: 所以现在，这些镜头中的大多数都是在婴儿刚出生时进行的。

segments.en: They're still in the hospital and they get a lot of vaccines to prevent them from getting these things.
segments.zh: 他们还在医院里，他们得到了很多疫苗来防止他们得到这些东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I remember when I was a kid, we didn't even have a vaccine for chicken pox.
segments.zh: 我记得当我还是个孩子的时候，我们甚至没有接种水痘疫苗。

segments.en: So these days there are more and more.
segments.zh: 所以这些日子越来越多。

segments.en: The oldest I think is the polio vaccine, the one that we hear the most about because it was a very serious disease that affected a lot of people up until the 1940s and 50s, I believe.
segments.zh: 我认为最古老的是脊髓灰质炎疫苗，我们最常听到的疫苗，因为它是一种非常严重的疾病，影响了很多人直到 1940 年代和 50 年代，我相信。

segments.en: So yeah, it's important really to read about these things and to educate yourself so that you know what you should get yourself and your kids.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，重要的是要阅读这些东西并教育自己，这样你就知道你应该得到什么你自己和你的孩子。

segments.en: That's exactly right because it's very important.
segments.zh: 这是完全正确的，因为它非常重要。

segments.en: Most of these diseases or most of these viruses have been eradicated because more and more people have had access to vaccines.
segments.zh: 由于越来越多的人获得疫苗，这些疾病中的大多数或这些病毒中的大多数已被根除。

segments.en: Like for example, polio, it's very rare you would say to actually get it nowadays because there's a vaccine, but it's very, very important I think.
segments.zh: 例如，脊髓灰质炎，你会说现在真正得到它是非常罕见的，因为有疫苗，但我认为它非常非常重要。

segments.en: But some people get a little bit too nervous.
segments.zh: 但是有些人会有点太紧张了。

segments.en: Like for example, whenever they travel to a tropical country, they're always afraid of yellow fever, so they get yellow fever shots.
segments.zh: 例如，每当他们去热带国家旅行时，他们总是害怕黄热病，所以他们会得到黄热病疫苗。

segments.en: But I've never really seen anyone get yellow fever because you go to like Thailand for a week.
segments.zh: 但我从未真正见过有人因为你喜欢泰国一个星期而患上黄热病。

segments.en: A friend of mine went to Thailand and got dengue fever.
segments.zh: 我的一个朋友去了泰国，得了登革热。

segments.en: So there's no vaccination for this, but it is a very painful disease you can get in tropical places.
segments.zh: 所以没有疫苗接种，但这是一种非常痛苦的疾病，你可以在热带地区接种。

segments.en: So I think the moral is talk to your doctor, see what he or she suggests because they will understand maybe better than you will.
segments.zh: 所以我认为道德是与您的医生交谈，看看他或她的建议，因为他们可能会比您更好地理解。

segments.en: And then just follow their advice for different places that you're traveling to.
segments.zh: 然后只需遵循他们对您要去的不同地方的建议。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for today, but if you guys have any questions or doubts, you can always visit us at our website EnglishPod.com and we'll be there to answer it.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们今天的所有时间，但如果你们有任何问题或疑问，您可以随时访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，我们会在那里回答。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
